ui.guideSteps: From a find to your doorstep

sections.heading: 1. Find a listing and keep its original link
paragraphs: Search the spreadsheet by product name or source item ID, or start with a category. Open the product page to inspect the available pictures and the price shown by CnBuyCha. These are research details, not a reservation of stock or a final quotation.

Keep the original seller URL with the size, colour and quantity you want. A catalogue number on Kakobuy Pick is different from the seller’s item ID. The Open in Kakobuy button carries the original seller URL into Kakobuy.

sections.heading: 2. Check the live options in Kakobuy
paragraphs: Register or sign in on kakobuy.com. Open the product link and compare the loaded title, seller, variant and quantity with your notes. The official buying guide describes both automatic import and a manual purchase form when information cannot be loaded.

Do not assume every marketplace link will import automatically. For a manual order, use the real listing information, explain the exact variant, and confirm any minimum quantity. Ask the purchaser about unclear options before paying.

sections.heading: 3. Pay for the purchase stage
paragraphs: Review the item price and the seller-to-warehouse postage. International delivery is a later stage. Keep enough room in your budget for the parcel quote, any payment charges and the optional services you choose.

The official fee pages describe several cost components and use different labels for some charges. Check the current payment breakdown in your own account instead of relying on a single advertised service-fee percentage.

sections.heading: 4. Review the items when they reach the warehouse
paragraphs: Check the status in your Kakobuy orders or warehouse. Compare the received item with the variant you selected: colour, visible size label, model, quantity and obvious damage. Read the inspection rules before treating a photo as proof of quality.

Reference pictures on Kakobuy Pick come from CnBuyCha and are not verified as warehouse QC. Use the pictures of your own order for a shipping decision. If something is wrong, contact support promptly and keep packaging and tags intact while a return is being considered.

sections.heading: 5. Choose packaging and an eligible route
paragraphs: Check the storage deadline for each item before waiting for more purchases. Enter your actual destination, parcel weight, dimensions and goods type in the official shipping estimator. Compare the permitted contents and billing rules of the available lines.

Decide whether to combine items and whether to retain, remove or reinforce packaging. A smaller box can reduce volumetric weight, but packaging also protects the contents. Confirm the effect on protection, return eligibility and the final quote before submitting the parcel.

sections.heading: 6. Track, receive and keep evidence
paragraphs: After dispatch, the official guide directs you to the parcel area of your account for tracking. Separate seller-to-warehouse movement from the international parcel: they have different records and timelines.

On arrival, inspect the outer box and seals, keep the label and packing materials, and record any damage or shortage. The official receipt guidance sets short reporting windows. Contact the carrier and Kakobuy promptly rather than waiting for an informal estimate from a third-party site.

faq.q: What does Kakobuy do?
faq.a: Kakobuy’s buying guide describes a purchasing-agent workflow: submit a seller listing, pay for the purchase, review warehouse inspection, then arrange international delivery. Kakobuy Pick is an independent discovery site; orders and payments are handled in your Kakobuy account.

faq.q: Is Kakobuy Pick the official Kakobuy website?
faq.a: No. Kakobuy Pick provides independent product research and guidance. Register and manage your account on kakobuy.com. Product purchase links may contain our affiliate code; this does not guarantee a discount or change the checks you should make.

faq.q: Where do the spreadsheet products and prices come from?
faq.a: Products, pictures, search results and sorting come from CnBuyCha. Prices are its displayed USD estimates. Confirm the current seller price, variant and stock in Kakobuy before paying; a spreadsheet entry is not a stock guarantee.

faq.q: How do I open a product in Kakobuy?
faq.a: Open a product detail page and choose Open in Kakobuy. Check the original seller listing, size, colour and quantity after the destination page loads. The link carries the original seller URL; the local catalogue ID must not be used as the seller’s item ID.

faq.q: What if a product link will not load automatically?
faq.a: The official buying guide includes a manual purchase form for listings that cannot be imported. Enter the actual seller URL and accurate item details. Do not invent a price or select a similar-looking product without checking the listing and asking the purchaser when necessary.

faq.q: Can a seller require a minimum quantity?
faq.a: Yes. Kakobuy’s buying guide specifically tells users to check the seller’s minimum quantity for 1688 products. Confirm the quantity requirement and the price for the exact variant before paying; the lowest displayed price may not describe your intended order.

faq.q: Does the displayed item price include international shipping?
faq.a: No. The official guide separates the purchase stage from parcel submission. Item cost and domestic postage are paid for purchasing; international freight and applicable parcel-related charges are checked later. Optional services and payment costs also need to be reviewed in the current breakdown.

faq.q: What is domestic shipping?
faq.a: It is the seller-to-Kakobuy-warehouse delivery within mainland China. The official fee guidance includes it in the purchase cost. It is separate from the international parcel quote and may vary by seller, quantity and listing.

faq.q: Does a zero service fee mean there are no other costs?
faq.a: No. The official services page still identifies product cost, international freight and declaration-related costs, with optional services purchased as needed. Other help pages use different fee labels. Review the current quotation; do not interpret a service-fee promotion as free delivery or an all-inclusive price.

faq.q: Which payment methods should I check?
faq.a: The official buying and top-up pages describe methods including PayPal, international cards, Alipay and WeChat. Availability, currency conversion and charges should be confirmed in your own checkout. This site does not collect payment details or promise that every method is available to every account.

faq.q: Why can a USD estimate differ from the amount I pay?
faq.a: A catalogue estimate is separate from the seller price, chosen variant, domestic postage and payment conversion. Kakobuy’s top-up page describes currency conversion and payment charges. Compare the final amount and currency shown by Kakobuy and your payment provider before confirming.

faq.q: What does the standard inspection check?
faq.a: The official inspection rules describe checks of visible order information such as style, quantity, colour, size and model. They also describe restrictions for sealed goods. Read those limits alongside your order photos; an external check does not reveal every hidden defect.

faq.q: Do QC photos prove authenticity or electronic functionality?
faq.a: No. Photos alone do not establish authenticity, durability or full working condition. Kakobuy’s inspection rules explicitly exclude authenticity, functionality and quality assessment for specialised goods such as electronics from the standard inspection scope.

faq.q: Are all photos on Kakobuy Pick warehouse QC photos?
faq.a: No. They are reference product images supplied by CnBuyCha; their warehouse-QC provenance has not been verified. Inspect the photos associated with your own order in Kakobuy before deciding to ship.

faq.q: How should I check sizing before ordering?
faq.a: Use the exact seller’s measurements and compare them with a well-fitting item you own. Confirm units and whether a number is a flat width or a full circumference. This is an editorial checking method, not a universal Kakobuy size chart or a guarantee of fit.

faq.q: What should I do if an order photo looks wrong?
faq.a: Compare it with your selected variant and order notes, identify the specific mismatch, and contact the purchaser through the order message area. Keep tags and packaging while a return is considered. Ask about any extra inspection or measurement service before assuming it is included.

faq.q: How long can a normal order stay in the warehouse?
faq.a: The storage policy checked on 17 October 2026 states 100 days for normal purchasing and forwarding parcels, starting from stored status. It describes a reminder after 90 days and possible disposal after expiry without submission or feedback. Confirm each item’s actual deadline in your account.

faq.q: Do unmatched or abnormal parcels have the same storage period?
faq.a: No. The same storage page gives 60 days for abnormal parcels, such as arrivals without an order or complete logistics information, starting from receipt. It warns that unmatched ownership can prevent reminders. Complete forwarding information promptly instead of assuming the normal period applies.

faq.q: How do I estimate international shipping?
faq.a: Use Kakobuy’s official estimator with the destination, weight in grams, goods type and parcel dimensions. Compare eligible routes and their current conditions. An estimate based on incomplete packing information is not a final invoice.

faq.q: What is volumetric weight?
faq.a: It is a size-based billing weight. The official example uses length × width × height in centimetres divided by the carrier’s divisor, then compares the result with actual weight. The divisor and applicability depend on the route; do not assume one number works for every line.

faq.q: Should I combine all items into one parcel?
faq.a: The official guide describes shipping purchases together, but the best choice depends on permitted contents, weight, dimensions and the quoted charges. Compare the combined and split options. Keep fragile goods protected and avoid holding items beyond their individual storage or return deadlines.

faq.q: How long will the whole order take?
faq.a: Separate purchasing, seller dispatch, warehouse processing and international transit. The official processing page describes packing within 24 hours and carrier collection within two working days, with weekend and holiday qualifications. These are published processing expectations, not a promised door-to-door delivery date.

faq.q: Where can I track an international parcel?
faq.a: The official buying guide directs users to the parcel area under My Account after dispatch. Check the record for the international parcel, not only the original purchase order. If progress is unclear, send the parcel number and latest tracking event to official support.

faq.q: Does the five-day return rule apply to every product?
faq.a: No. The official return rules are conditional on seller acceptance, product eligibility, condition and timing after warehouse storage. Some categories and altered packaging are excluded. Check the order’s deadline and eligibility promptly; 100-day storage is not a 100-day return right.

faq.q: Are return postage and refunds always free or immediate?
faq.a: No. The official rules distinguish reasons for return, postage, service fees and seller confirmation. Approval and refund timing depend on the order. Ask for the applicable cost breakdown before authorising a return, and check whether the refund is credited to your Kakobuy balance.

faq.q: What if my delivered parcel is damaged or incomplete?
faq.a: Keep the outer packaging, seals, shipping label and clear evidence. The receipt guidance asks users to report relevant issues to the local carrier within two days and abnormal parcels to Kakobuy within 72 hours of receipt. Contact both promptly and confirm the requirements for your route.

articles.title: How to use a Kakobuy spreadsheet without losing track of the details
articles.description: Build a useful shortlist, compare live seller links and keep price, variant and photo evidence attached to the right item.

sections.heading: Start with a decision, not a huge list
paragraphs: A Kakobuy spreadsheet is useful when it turns browsing into a specific purchasing decision. Start with one category, an item budget and the characteristics that matter to you. For a jacket, those may be length, fabric, lining and space for layers. For a bag, dimensions and closure may matter more than a familiar product name. A shortlist of three relevant listings is easier to verify than dozens of saved screenshots.

Kakobuy Pick reads the CnBuyCha catalogue for product details and prices. Its search and category filters help you narrow that catalogue; they do not rank a seller’s reliability. A popular result reflects browsing activity, not a verified count of completed purchases or a quality certification.

sections.heading: Keep a small record for each candidate
paragraphs: Record the original seller URL, the intended colour or style, the size, the quantity and the date you checked it. Save your own notes alongside the link. A title can appear on several listings, and the cheapest option displayed on a page may be a different variant. Your notes should let you return to the exact option without reconstructing the decision from memory.

A useful comparison has a separate column for unanswered questions. Write “measurement missing” or “domestic postage not checked” rather than quietly treating missing information as zero cost or a good fit. This makes the next action obvious and stops an attractive photograph from filling gaps in the evidence.

sections.heading: Use photos for the questions they can answer
paragraphs: Open the available gallery and look for the views needed for your decision. A front image may show colour and shape but not a zip, label or interior pocket. Zooming a low-resolution image cannot reveal details that were never captured. If a feature matters and the image does not show it, leave it unresolved.

Pictures on this site are CnBuyCha reference images. Their warehouse-QC provenance has not been verified. They should not be presented as photographs of the item you will receive. The official Kakobuy inspection rules also limit what warehouse checks establish; photos do not prove authenticity, functional performance or long-term durability.

sections.heading: Compare the full commitment
paragraphs: The displayed USD estimate is a starting point for comparison. Check the live variant price and seller-to-warehouse postage in Kakobuy, then keep international freight and optional services separate in your budget. A lower item price does not necessarily make the delivered order cheaper. A bulky item may create a larger parcel than a slightly more expensive compact alternative.

Do not invent a shipping figure just to complete your comparison. Mark it as an estimate until you have usable weight and dimensions. Recheck the total once the actual order reaches the warehouse and you can compare eligible routes.

sections.heading: Reopen the source before committing
paragraphs: Use Open in Kakobuy and compare the loaded page with your shortlist. Check that the seller item, variant and quantity match. The official buying guide explains that some links may need manual entry; a failed import is a reason to verify the source, not to choose the nearest-looking result.

Make a final decision only after the unanswered questions are resolved or consciously accepted. Keep the order details so you can compare them with the warehouse arrival later. This simple record connects research, payment and inspection into one traceable process without treating the spreadsheet as a guarantee.

checklist: Keep the original seller URL and exact option together.
Use popularity as a discovery signal, not proof of quality.
Separate estimated item price from the delivered total.
Compare your own order photos before international shipping.

Item price, domestic postage and shipping assumptions
Photo source, date checked and order notes

articles.title: Kakobuy product links: Weidian, Taobao, 1688 and manual orders
articles.description: Check the original seller URL, identify import problems and prepare an accurate manual order when the live page requires it.

sections.heading: Follow the identity of the item
paragraphs: A purchase link is useful only if it carries the correct seller listing. Distinguish the original marketplace URL from the Kakobuy page that imports it and from the local catalogue URL you used to discover it. These are three different addresses with different purposes. The local product number is not automatically the seller’s item number.

On Kakobuy Pick, Open in Kakobuy passes the known original seller URL to Kakobuy. After it opens, compare the actual title, pictures and options with the source. The existence of an affiliate parameter says nothing about stock, price or whether the import has selected the right variant.

sections.heading: Check the source before troubleshooting the agent page
paragraphs: If an imported product looks wrong, first reopen the original listing. Check whether the seller has changed the product, removed an option or stopped selling it. A saved link can remain reachable while its content changes. Keep a note of the seller item ID and the option you intended to buy.

When copying a link, use a specific product page rather than a shop home page, collection page or unrelated advertisement. If the seller uses a short sharing link, confirm what product it opens before submitting it. Avoid guessing missing item IDs from filenames, photographs or similar listings.

sections.heading: Automatic import is not a universal promise
paragraphs: Kakobuy’s official buying guide describes automatic capture for supported listings and a manual purchase form when necessary. It also gives platform-specific notes that do not justify claiming every Weidian, Taobao or 1688 URL always imports. The current product page and order flow are the practical checks for your particular listing.

An import failure may leave the price, options or delivery details incomplete. Do not fill those gaps with invented values. A search result from a different seller may be a different product even if the photograph looks identical. Verify the replacement separately before treating it as an alternative.

sections.heading: Prepare a manual order that can be understood
paragraphs: Use the actual seller URL and the item’s real name, selected size, colour, quantity and current price information. Include a concise note when an option name is ambiguous. The goal is to make the intended purchase unambiguous to the purchaser, not to paste every line of a sales page into the notes.

For example, “Black, size M, one piece; confirm the chest measurement in the seller chart before purchasing” is more useful than “the one in the photo.” This is an editorial example, not a required Kakobuy template. If you cannot establish the price or domestic postage, ask for clarification through the official flow.

sections.heading: Read quantity and price conditions carefully
paragraphs: The official guide specifically warns about minimum purchase quantities on 1688. A displayed price can depend on quantity or variant. Check whether your intended order meets the seller’s requirement before comparing it with a one-piece offer elsewhere. Also check whether the chosen quantity changes domestic postage.

Before paying, review the order summary as a whole: correct item, correct option, correct quantity and a complete purchase cost. Save the resulting order number and notes. If an issue appears later, these details help support compare the purchase request with the received item.

checklist: Open the original product page and verify its identity.
Never substitute a local catalogue ID for a seller item ID.
Use manual entry only with real listing information.
Check minimum quantities and the final selected variant.

table.caption: Three links, three purposes
rows: Verify the item, seller and options
Review the import and place the purchase order

articles.title: Kakobuy QC photos: a practical inspection checklist and its limits
articles.description: Review visible order details, ask precise follow-up questions and separate reference images from the inspection of your own purchase.

sections.heading: Identify what you are actually looking at
paragraphs: Before judging a photo, establish its source. Seller photography, another buyer’s historical images and the pictures attached to your own warehouse order serve different purposes. A good-looking reference image does not prove that your item has arrived in the same condition. Keep the order number and selected variant visible while reviewing your own inspection.

The pictures on Kakobuy Pick come from CnBuyCha. We have not verified them as warehouse QC. Use them to research visible features, then use the photos associated with your own Kakobuy order to decide what needs checking before shipment.

sections.heading: Read the standard inspection scope
paragraphs: Kakobuy’s published inspection rules focus on visible details such as style, quantity, colour, size and model. They describe restrictions on opening sealed goods and on inspecting the contents of certain sealed non-clothing items. Treat this as a defined service scope, not a promise that every hidden problem has been tested.

The same rules exclude authenticity, functionality and quality assessments for specialised goods such as electronics from standard inspection. A photograph of a powered device would not, by itself, establish battery health, electrical safety or long-term reliability. Ask what a requested extra check can actually establish before relying on it.

sections.heading: Review identity before minor cosmetic details
paragraphs: Start with whether the received item matches the order at all. Compare the visible colour, style, label, model and number of pieces with the selected option. For a set, confirm that all expected components are represented. For a pair, look at both items. This prevents a small stitching discussion from distracting you from an incorrect variant.

Next inspect the views for visible damage, stains, uneven construction or missing parts. A photograph may hide a surface, distort proportions or shift colour under lighting. Describe the uncertainty precisely instead of turning an unclear image into a definite defect claim.

sections.heading: Request evidence that answers one question
paragraphs: A focused request is easier to act on: ask for the label, the relevant closure, the inside pocket or a clearly positioned measurement. State which order and which part you mean. Confirm availability and any charge for extra photographs or measurements through Kakobuy before assuming the service is included.

For a measurement photo, explain the start and end points and whether you need a flat width or circumference. A ruler placed at an angle or a garment stretched differently can give a misleading comparison. Your request should make the method reproducible, especially if you are comparing it with an item you already own.

sections.heading: Decide before changing the packaging
paragraphs: If something does not match, save the relevant images and contact the purchaser through the order message area. Keep the original tags and packaging while the issue is assessed. The return rules include condition requirements and exclusions for items whose packaging or labels have been removed.

Avoid approving a parcel simply because you have waited a long time. Equally, avoid assuming every visible irregularity qualifies for a free return. Separate an established mismatch from a preference or an unresolved question, then ask for the available remedy and its cost before deciding.

checklist: Match the photo to your own order and selected option.
Check identity, quantity and obvious damage first.
Ask one precise question when a view is missing.
Keep tags and packaging until return questions are resolved.

table.caption: What a photo can and cannot establish

articles.title: Kakobuy sizing guide: compare measurements before choosing a label
articles.description: Use the seller’s chart, a consistent measuring method and specific order notes for clothing, footwear and accessories.

sections.heading: There is no universal Kakobuy size chart
paragraphs: Kakobuy is the purchasing intermediary; the seller and the particular product determine the available sizes. A letter such as M or L is not enough to compare two unrelated listings. Even a familiar model name may be offered by different sellers with different measurements or options. Start with the chart for the exact listing you intend to order.

This guide offers a practical comparison method rather than a guaranteed conversion between countries or brands. Do not automatically size up or down because a comment about another product recommends it. Use measurements and intended fit to make the decision.

sections.heading: Create a reference you can repeat
paragraphs: Choose a garment you already wear comfortably and measure it flat without stretching. For a top, useful points include chest width, shoulder width, sleeve length and body length. For trousers, record waist measurement, rise and leg length using the same approach as the seller’s chart. Note the units and the measurement positions.

Flat width and circumference are not interchangeable. A 54 cm flat chest width is a different kind of measurement from a 54 cm chest circumference. Do not double or halve a number until the chart’s method is clear. If the seller’s diagram is unclear, ask before placing the order.

sections.heading: Compare fit, fabric and the intended use
paragraphs: Two garments with similar measurements can feel different because of cut, stretch, thickness and layering. A jacket worn over a hoodie needs a different decision from a close-fitting base layer. Compare the shape of the garment as well as the numbers; a wide body with short sleeves is not equivalent to a longer, narrower cut.

Write down the difference between the reference and the listing. For example, a listing that is 2 cm wider and 3 cm shorter than your reference presents a specific fit trade-off. Those numbers are an illustrative comparison, not a recommendation that this amount of difference will suit everyone.

sections.heading: Treat footwear and accessories separately
paragraphs: For footwear, check which sizing system the listing uses and what its length measurement describes. Foot length, insole length and outsole length are different measurements. A conversion chart cannot resolve width, toe shape or personal comfort. Use the exact seller’s information and ask for clarification if the available numbers are ambiguous.

For a bag, consider width, height, depth, opening and strap length. A bag can have enough overall volume but an opening too small for the item you want to carry. For accessories, identify the dimension that affects use rather than assuming that a product photo communicates scale accurately.

sections.heading: Connect the sizing decision to inspection
paragraphs: Include the selected size and any important clarification in your order notes. When the item arrives, compare its visible label with the order. The official inspection rules include size information among the visible checks, but that does not mean standard inspection proves a comfortable fit or includes every measurement you might want.

If you need a measurement photograph, ask about the method, availability and cost before relying on it. Raise a mismatch while the return question can still be considered and keep tags and packaging. A careful sizing record is useful evidence; it does not remove seller conditions or guarantee a free exchange.

checklist: Use the chart for the exact seller listing.
Record units and whether a measurement is flat or around the body.
Compare with a well-fitting reference using the same method.
Keep the selected option and any clarification in your order notes.

table.caption: Build a category-specific measurement record
rows: Chest width, shoulders, sleeves, length, layering
Waist method, rise, leg length and cut
Sizing system, stated length method and width
Width, height, depth, opening and strap length

articles.title: Kakobuy shipping calculator: weight, dimensions and a useful comparison
articles.description: Prepare accurate estimator inputs and compare chargeable weight without mistaking an illustrative calculation for a live shipping quote.

sections.heading: Use the official estimator before committing to a parcel
paragraphs: A useful Kakobuy shipping estimate starts with the destination, the goods type, the weight and the package dimensions. The official estimator exposes these inputs because a price depends on more than the number of items. Two parcels containing the same number of products may have very different weights and volumes.

Enter the real destination and product characteristics. A route that looks inexpensive for ordinary clothing may not accept the contents of another parcel. Treat the routes returned for your actual input as candidates to read carefully, not a permanent list of services available everywhere.

sections.heading: Keep grams and kilograms consistent
paragraphs: The estimator asks for weight in grams. A parcel weighing 4 kg should therefore be represented as 4000 g in that field. Write down your assumptions when you do not yet know the final packed weight. Product-only weight excludes some packing materials, while a rough shopping-list estimate may miss boxes and accessories entirely.

When warehouse information becomes available, replace estimates with the better figures. Do not compare a packed weight on one route with an unboxed product estimate on another and call the difference a discount. Both quotations should describe the same intended parcel.

sections.heading: Calculate volumetric weight using the route’s divisor
paragraphs: Kakobuy’s official explanation describes volumetric weight as length × width × height in centimetres divided by the carrier-specific divisor. Its examples mention several possible divisors. It then compares volumetric and actual weight for applicable routes. The important step is reading the divisor and billing conditions of the particular line.

As an editorial example, a 40 × 30 × 30 cm box has a volume of 36,000 cubic centimetres. Dividing by 6000 gives 6 kg; dividing by 5000 gives 7.2 kg. If actual weight is 4 kg and the route charges the greater figure, those assumptions produce 6 kg or 7.2 kg of chargeable weight. These are weight calculations, not shipping prices.

sections.heading: Compare like for like
paragraphs: Use the same destination, contents, weight and dimensions when comparing routes. Then record the quoted total, relevant restrictions, estimated transit window and any optional service you actually want. Read whether a displayed amount is an initial estimate and how the final parcel is measured or adjusted.

A headline price alone cannot tell you whether the service fits your needs. A higher quote may accompany different delivery handling or conditions; a lower quote may involve restrictions that matter to your parcel. Choose based on the complete terms presented in the current quotation rather than an unsupported “best line” claim.

sections.heading: Recheck after packing decisions
paragraphs: Removing a box, adding reinforcement or combining items can change dimensions and weight. Request a revised comparison when a change is material. A reduction in volumetric weight may help, but it is not a reason to remove protection required by a fragile item. Keep the physical contents and protection needs in the decision.

Save the inputs and quotation date so you know what the estimate described. The official estimator notes that third-party carriers can adjust rates. An old quote or someone else’s parcel screenshot is therefore a reference, not a price commitment for your shipment.

checklist: Use the actual destination, goods type and dimensions.
Enter grams where the estimator requests grams.
Read the divisor and billing rules for the selected route.
Refresh the quote after meaningful packing changes.

table.caption: Illustrative volumetric calculation — not a live quote
rows: 6 kg or 7.2 kg, depending on the divisor

articles.title: Kakobuy fees and payment: build a budget beyond the item price
articles.description: Separate purchase cost, international delivery, optional services and payment conversion before deciding how much to spend.

sections.heading: Separate the purchase from the parcel
paragraphs: The first useful budget distinction is between buying the item and sending it internationally. Kakobuy’s official buying guide treats these as separate stages. The purchase includes the seller’s item price and domestic postage to the warehouse. A later parcel submission introduces the international route and the services selected for that shipment.

A price on Kakobuy Pick is the USD estimate displayed by CnBuyCha, not a payable all-inclusive invoice. The selected variant, quantity and live seller price may differ from the catalogue reference. Keep that distinction clear when comparing items or planning a larger order.

sections.heading: Read fee labels in context
paragraphs: The official services page advertises zero service fees while still identifying product, international shipping and declaration-related costs. Another cost-calculation page uses packing and optional-service terminology. These pages should not be collapsed into a claim that every possible charge is zero or that one fixed amount applies to every route.

Use the current checkout and parcel quotation as the decision record. If a label is unclear, ask what it covers and whether it is already included in another amount. This is particularly useful when comparing a purchase-stage subtotal with a later shipping-stage total: the two numbers describe different commitments.

sections.heading: Use a budget with known and unknown amounts
paragraphs: List the item cost, domestic postage, expected international freight and any optional services separately. Add payment or conversion charges only when you can identify them in the actual payment flow. Leave unknown amounts clearly marked as estimates instead of hiding them inside a single apparently precise total.

For illustration, an item amount of 30 USD, domestic postage of 3 USD and an international quote of 18 USD produce a 51 USD subtotal before other applicable charges. These are invented arithmetic inputs for explanation, not Kakobuy prices. If the shipping input is only a guess, the subtotal remains a planning estimate.

sections.heading: Check the payment amount and currency
paragraphs: The official top-up guidance describes multiple methods, currency conversion and method-specific charges. Availability and conditions should be checked in your account at the time of payment. A familiar payment logo does not guarantee that the same method, currency or charge is available for every country or account.

Compare the amount being paid, the balance being credited and the currency conversion shown. Your payment provider may present its own conversion decision. Keep a receipt of the confirmed transaction and avoid comparing a converted account balance with a different currency amount as though they were identical.

sections.heading: Keep a record for later adjustments
paragraphs: Save the purchase summary and parcel quote separately. If a shipping adjustment or refund appears, this makes it easier to identify which stage it relates to. A refund credited to an account balance is not the same event as money arriving back at an external payment method; check the applicable process before assuming completion.

A sensible budget also leaves room for an unresolved cost before buying more items. The goal is not to predict every charge perfectly at the browsing stage. It is to know which amounts are confirmed, which are provisional and which decision will reveal the missing information.

checklist: Separate item purchase and international parcel expenses.
Review the current breakdown rather than a single fee headline.
Keep payment currency and credited balance distinct.
Save receipts and identify where any refund is credited.

articles.title: Kakobuy warehouse storage: deadlines, unmatched parcels and return timing
articles.description: Understand the official storage periods and keep each item’s warehouse deadline separate from its return eligibility.

sections.heading: Track each item, not just the newest arrival
paragraphs: A warehouse can make a multi-seller order easier to organise, but the items do not necessarily arrive on the same day. Build a small record containing each order number, arrival or stored date, status and the next action. Waiting for the final item should not make you lose sight of the oldest one.

Use the dates and status displayed in your own Kakobuy account. A seller’s dispatch date is not necessarily the date that starts the warehouse storage clock. When the status is unclear, ask support which date applies rather than estimating from a domestic tracking screenshot.

sections.heading: Read the normal storage rule with its conditions
paragraphs: The official storage page checked on 17 October 2026 states a 100-day period for normal purchasing and forwarding parcels, starting from stored status. It describes a reminder after 90 days and warns about disposal after expiry when there has been no parcel submission or feedback. Confirm the current rule and the individual deadline before planning to wait.

A reminder is a useful extra signal, not a substitute for your own record. Keep contact information current and do not assume that an unread email, a holiday or an intention to purchase more goods automatically extends storage. Ask about your options before a deadline becomes urgent.

sections.heading: Resolve unmatched arrivals promptly
paragraphs: The same official page treats abnormal parcels differently. It describes a 60-day period from receipt for arrivals without the necessary order or complete logistics information, and explains that unmatched ownership can prevent reminders. This is a separate case from a normal order already associated with your account.

If a forwarding parcel has arrived but you cannot match it to an order, prepare the real tracking number, sender details and purchase evidence. Use the official account or support process to resolve the association. Do not create guessed records or assume an unknown parcel will be safely held indefinitely.

sections.heading: Storage time is not return time
paragraphs: Warehouse storage and seller return eligibility answer different questions. Storage concerns how long the goods remain held; returns concern whether a seller will take an item back under the applicable conditions. Kakobuy’s published five-day return rules contain eligibility, timing and condition requirements that are much shorter than normal storage.

Review an item soon after arrival, particularly if its size, colour or condition is uncertain. Keeping it in storage does not pause every seller deadline. Avoid postponing inspection until all the other items arrive if that means an earlier item’s return window may close.

sections.heading: Plan the next action before combining items
paragraphs: Once the items have been checked, compare shipping them together with splitting them into suitable parcels. Use actual contents, dimensions and route restrictions in that comparison. Do not hold a resolved item solely to chase a hypothetical saving that has never been quoted.

Keep a clear next action for every line in your record: await seller dispatch, inspect, ask a question, request a return, or submit a parcel. This makes a larger order manageable and helps you decide when waiting no longer serves the purchase plan. It is an editorial organisation method, not a promise of additional storage services.

checklist: Record the status and deadline of every order separately.
Check the current normal and abnormal-parcel rules.
Resolve missing forwarding information promptly.
Review return eligibility long before storage expires.

articles.title: Kakobuy consolidation and packaging: compare protection with parcel size
articles.description: Make a reasoned packing decision using volume, fragile contents, route limits and return conditions rather than assuming one parcel is always cheaper.

sections.heading: Begin with the contents that need protection
paragraphs: Consolidation means arranging items into a shipment together. Kakobuy’s official guide describes sending purchases together and selecting packaging-related services. The useful question is not simply whether combining is possible, but whether the resulting parcel suits the contents and the available route.

List items that are fragile, crushable, unusually shaped or sensitive to pressure. A garment and a structured accessory may need different packing decisions. The same applies to retaining a retail box: it may be unwanted bulk for one purchase and useful protection or part of the purchase for another.

sections.heading: Compare two concrete parcel plans
paragraphs: Create a combined option and a split option using the best available weight and dimensions. Enter the relevant goods type and destination in the official estimator. Compare complete quoted amounts and permitted contents rather than dividing a hypothetical freight cost by the number of items.

Combining may reduce repeated charges, but a larger package may also cross a weight or size condition or increase volumetric billing. Splitting creates more parcels and may repeat charges. The correct answer depends on the actual quotations and restrictions; there is no universal saving percentage to apply.

sections.heading: Understand how dimensions affect the quote
paragraphs: The official volumetric-weight explanation compares size-based and actual weight for applicable lines. Removing empty space can therefore matter even if the contents weigh the same. The effect depends on the line’s divisor and billing conditions, which must be checked in the current quotation.

As an editorial example, a 40 × 30 × 30 cm box gives 6 kg of volumetric weight with a divisor of 6000. Reducing the height to 20 cm gives 4 kg using the same assumption. That illustrates the effect of volume, but it does not establish that the smaller box is safe for the contents or that the price will fall by the same percentage.

sections.heading: Do not remove evidence before resolving a return
paragraphs: Packing decisions can have consequences beyond postage. Kakobuy’s return rules include exclusions or conditions involving removed packaging, labels and accessories. If an order is still under review, leave those materials intact while discussing the remedy with the purchaser.

Ask for a clear explanation before requesting removal, reinforcement or another extra service. Establish what will be removed or added, whether it can be reversed and whether there is a charge. A vague instruction such as “make it as small as possible” may not communicate what you need protected.

sections.heading: Confirm the final plan
paragraphs: Before submission, check the recipient address, the accepted contents, the selected route and the packing services you actually want. If a change alters the dimensions or weight substantially, compare the updated quote. Keep the chosen plan with the parcel record so you can understand any later adjustment.

Consolidation works best after product questions are resolved. Combining an item with an unresolved return issue can make the process harder. Complete inspection first, then decide how to move the accepted items safely and within their storage deadlines.

checklist: Identify fragile items and packaging you need to keep.
Compare a combined and a split plan using current quotes.
Check dimensions as well as actual weight.
Resolve returns before requesting irreversible packing changes.

articles.title: Kakobuy shipping time and tracking: follow the right stage
articles.description: Separate seller dispatch, warehouse processing and international transit so that a tracking update answers the question you are actually asking.

sections.heading: One order has more than one journey
paragraphs: A Kakobuy purchase is not a single uninterrupted shipping event. The seller sends goods to the warehouse; Kakobuy receives and processes them; you submit an international parcel; the selected carrier moves that parcel to the destination. Each stage can have its own record and its own waiting time.

This distinction explains a common misunderstanding: a domestic tracking entry marked delivered may mean delivered to the warehouse, not to your home. Match the tracking number to the stage before concluding that a parcel is missing or that international shipping has already started.

sections.heading: Use published processing expectations carefully
paragraphs: The official parcel-processing page checked on 17 October 2026 describes packing within 24 hours after submission and carrier collection within two working days, with weekends and statutory holidays affecting collection. These are published operational expectations for that stage, not a guaranteed date for the entire purchase to reach your door.

Seller preparation, domestic delivery, warehouse issues, route transit and destination delivery are separate factors. Do not add an old forum estimate to a current route estimate and present the result as a promise. Read the live status and ask about a specific delayed step when necessary.

sections.heading: Track the international parcel after dispatch
paragraphs: Kakobuy’s buying guide directs users to the parcel area under My Account after dispatch. Locate the parcel number and the tracking information associated with that shipment. Keep it separate from purchase order numbers and seller-to-warehouse tracking.

When a status changes, record what the event actually says and when it occurred. An electronic shipping record, a carrier collection scan and a destination delivery event are different pieces of evidence. If the wording is unclear, ask the carrier or Kakobuy to identify the stage rather than inventing a location or arrival date.

sections.heading: Prepare a concise support request
paragraphs: Provide the parcel number, the selected line, the latest visible tracking event and the date of that event. Explain the specific question: whether collection occurred, which tracking number is current or what evidence is needed for a delivery issue. Keep payment details and identity documents out of public posts.

A useful message might say, “Parcel number X shows event Y dated Z; can you confirm the current stage and the next action required from me?” This is an editorial template. It asks for a verifiable update without assuming the parcel is lost solely because a scan has not changed.

sections.heading: Plan for receipt as well as transit
paragraphs: Once delivery is close, check the contact details and any carrier instructions. When the parcel arrives, inspect its outer condition and keep the label, seals and packaging. Record shortages or damage clearly. The official receipt page describes short reporting windows, so raise an issue promptly instead of waiting for a general tracking discussion to resolve it.

A practical timeline therefore ends with evidence of receipt and any issue report, not simply with the first delivered scan. Use the official account and carrier records for follow-up. A third-party article can explain the workflow, but it cannot locate your parcel or guarantee when an investigation will finish.

checklist: Match each tracking number to its delivery stage.
Treat processing estimates separately from international transit.
Ask support a specific question with the parcel record.
Keep packaging and report delivery problems promptly.

articles.title: Kakobuy returns and refunds: eligibility, evidence and the five-day rule
articles.description: Check seller conditions early, preserve packaging and understand the difference between a return request, approval and a completed refund.

sections.heading: Identify the problem and the current stage
paragraphs: Start with the order status and the reason for the request. Cancelling before seller dispatch, returning an item already in the warehouse and reporting damage after international delivery are different situations. The information needed and the available remedies may differ. Use the relevant order or parcel record when contacting support.

Describe the issue factually: wrong selected colour, missing component, visible damage or a change of preference. Save the selected variant and the relevant images. A clear description helps distinguish an established mismatch from a question that still needs inspection.

sections.heading: Read the five-day rule with its conditions
paragraphs: The official return page describes a five-day warehouse-stage return or exchange framework, but it is not an unconditional promise for every product. Seller acceptance, category, item condition and the timing of the request all matter. The page lists exclusions, including some customised or personal-use goods and items whose packaging or labels have been removed.

Check the actual deadline in the order as soon as the item is stored. Do not wait for the normal 100-day storage period to end: storage and return eligibility are separate clocks. If the stated return period has passed, ask what is possible without assuming the seller must accept the item.

sections.heading: Preserve the condition needed for a remedy
paragraphs: Keep labels, packaging, accessories and any protective seals while a return is being considered. Avoid asking for repacking or label removal until the decision is resolved. This is particularly important when the seller requires the goods to remain suitable for resale or when sealed packaging has special conditions.

For a visible defect, save a clear view of the issue and the wider item. For an incorrect variant, keep the order selection and the identifying label or colour view. Do not alter photos to exaggerate an issue. Evidence should make the actual mismatch easy to understand.

sections.heading: Ask for the cost and refund path
paragraphs: A return can involve domestic postage, service charges and seller confirmation. The official rules distinguish different reasons and circumstances, so a statement such as “returns are free” is too broad. Ask which costs apply to this order and who bears them before authorising the next step.

The return request, seller approval, physical return and credit of the refund are separate events. The official page describes refunds to the Kakobuy account balance in relevant cases. Do not assume that a balance credit means the same amount has already reached your bank or payment provider; confirm any separate withdrawal process through the account.

sections.heading: Use the delivery-issue process when appropriate
paragraphs: If the problem is discovered after international delivery, keep the outer box, seals, shipping label and evidence of the contents. The official receipt guidance describes reporting relevant problems to the local carrier within two days and abnormal parcels to Kakobuy within 72 hours of receipt. Check the current requirements for your route and act promptly.

Maintain a simple case record with the order or parcel number, the requested remedy, the evidence sent and the latest response. This keeps follow-up focused and helps you see which step is pending. It supports a clear request but does not guarantee seller approval, compensation or a fixed refund date.

checklist: Check the order stage and the actual return deadline.
Keep tags, packaging and accessories intact.
Ask for postage, service costs and the refund destination.
Use prompt carrier and Kakobuy reporting for delivery damage.
